name: d(n) (also called tau(n) or sigma_0(n)), the number of divisors of n.
role: rectangles by area, the bottom rung of the convex-polyomino ladder

name: Expansion of Product_{m >= 1} (1 + x^m); number of partitions of n into distinct parts; number of partitions of n into odd parts.
role: multiset partitions c* of one element repeated n times (distinct-part partitions)

name: Lucas numbers beginning at 2: L(n) = L(n-1) + L(n-2), L(0) = 2, L(1) = 1.
role: Lucas numbers (companion of Fibonacci)

name: a(n) is the number of partitions of n (the partition numbers).
role: Ferrers diagrams by area

name: Fibonacci numbers: F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2) with F(0) = 0 and F(1) = 1.
role: tree castles of height 2 (T_2(w) = F_{w+2}); Fibonacci in prime-castle count

name: Tribonacci numbers: a(n) = a(n-1) + a(n-2) + a(n-3) for n >= 3 with a(0) = a(1) = 0 and a(2) = 1.
role: bounded-height castles by area, height ≤ 3: tribonacci, `=A000073(A+2)`

name: Tetranacci numbers: a(n) = a(n-1) + a(n-2) + a(n-3) + a(n-4) for n >= 4 with a(0) = a(1) = a(2) = 0 and a(3) = 1.
role: bounded-height castles by area, height ≤ 4: tetranacci, `=A000078(A+3)`

name: Powers of 2: a(n) = 2^n.
role: powers of 2 (P_even(2,L) = 2^L)

name: Central polygonal numbers (the Lazy Caterer's sequence): n(n+1)/2 + 1; or, maximal number of pieces formed when slicing a pancake with n cuts.
role: unimodal height-2 castles `1 + C(w+1,2)`, the `g -> infinity` limit of the `h=2` tower-spacing row

name: Pell numbers: a(0) = 0, a(1) = 1; for n > 1, a(n) = 2*a(n-1) + a(n-2).
role: anchored 1-smooth height-≤3 castle strip, `P_{w+1}` (the Pell castle strip); integer realization of 1 + √2

name: Factorial numbers: n! = 1*2*3*4*...*n (order of symmetric group S_n, number of permutations of n letters).
role: rainbow castles: exactly h! at width h

name: Triangular numbers: a(n) = binomial(n+1,2) = n*(n+1)/2 = 0 + 1 + 2 + ... + n.
role: height-2 castles whose second row is a single run; F(4,2) = C(5,2) = 10

name: a(n) = 2^n - 1. (Sometimes called Mersenne numbers, although that name is usually reserved for A001348.)
role: total height-2 castles (Mersenne): F(w,2) + odd(w,2) = 2^w - 1

name: Number of outcomes of unlabeled n-team round-robin tournaments.
role: ambient count for unique tournaments; A000568(8) = 6880 is the isomorphism-class count the tree-castle bijection was checked against

name: Number of tournaments on n nodes determined by their score vectors.
role: tree castles of height 4 by area: T_(h=4)(A) = A000570(A+1); Tetali's classification of the four basic unique tournaments (sizes 1, 3, 4, 5) is proved in [[tetali-1998-unique-tournaments](pages/tetali-1998-unique-tournaments.md)] (JCTB 72:157-159, 1998), ingested to `raw/`

name: Number of different score sequences that are possible in an n-team round-robin tournament.
role: upper bound on unique tournaments u_n ≤ A000571(n), equality through n = 4

name: Expansion of Product_{k>=0} (1 + x^(2k+1)); number of partitions of n into distinct odd parts; number of self-conjugate partitions; number of symmetric Ferrers graphs with n nodes.
role: height-signed Ferrers diagrams by area, `(-1)^n A000700(n)`

name: a(n) = 4*a(n-1) - 6*a(n-2) + 4*a(n-3), n > 3, with a(0)=a(1)=a(2)=0, a(3)=1.
role: sum of every 4th binomial (hyperbolic family, k=3 residue)

name: Narayana's cows sequence: a(0) = a(1) = a(2) = 1; thereafter a(n) = a(n-1) + a(n-3).
role: tree castles of height 2 by area: T_(h=2)(A) = A000930(A+1)

name: Padovan sequence (or Padovan numbers): a(n) = a(n-2) + a(n-3) with a(0) = 1, a(1) = a(2) = 0.
role: Padovan (plastic Fibonacci): a(n) = a(n-2) + a(n-3)

name: Number of partially ordered sets ("posets") with n labeled elements (or labeled acyclic transitive digraphs).
role: strip rules whose half-column has nonnegative weights: 3, 19, 219 at heights 2, 3, 4; the rule is a poset on the heights (fractional-width-and-height)

name: Jacobsthal sequence (or Jacobsthal numbers): a(n) = a(n-1) + 2*a(n-2), with a(0) = 0, a(1) = 1; also a(n) = nearest integer to 2^n/3.
role: tree castles of height 3: T_3(w) = J_{w+2} (Jacobsthal)

name: a(n) = 3^n - 2^n.
role: h^w - (h-1)^w at h=3: total h=3 castles

name: Denominators of continued fraction convergents to sqrt(5).
role: denominators of CF convergents to √5; copper Fibonacci-3 sequence

name: Numerators of continued fraction convergents to sqrt(5).
role: numerators of CF convergents to √5

name: Number of fixed polyominoes with n cells.
role: fixed polyominoes

name: Number of board-pile polyominoes with n cells.
role: board-pile polyominoes (horizontally convex)

name: Taxi-cab numbers: sums of 2 cubes in more than 1 way.
role: 1729 = F(6,4) is the first term; no other taxicab number is a castle count for w,h <= 40

name: Triangle of Narayana numbers T(n,k) = C(n-1,k-1)*C(n,k-1)/k with 1 <= k <= n, read by rows. Also called the Catalan triangle.
role: tower Narayana polynomial coefficients

name: Pell-Lucas numbers: numerators of continued fraction convergents to sqrt(2).
role: numerators of CF convergents to √2 (Pell-Lucas)
sandpile group order (spanning trees) of the 2-wide ladder castle (2,...,2) of width n: |K| = A001353(n), cyclic

name: a(n) = 3*a(n-1) - a(n-2) for n >= 2, with a(0) = a(1) = 1.
role: convex castles (stack polyominoes) by semi-perimeter: anti-diagonal sums of C(2h+w-3, w-1)

name: Number of stacks, or planar partitions of n; also number of weakly unimodal compositions of n.
role: convex castles by area (weakly unimodal compositions)

name: Pentanacci numbers: a(n) = a(n-1) + a(n-2) + a(n-3) + a(n-4) + a(n-5), a(0)=a(1)=a(2)=a(3)=0, a(4)=1.
role: bounded-height castles by area, height ≤ 5: pentanacci, `=A001591(A+4)`

name: Perrin sequence (or Perrin numbers, or Ondrej Such sequence): a(n) = a(n-2) + a(n-3) with a(0) = 3, a(1) = 0, a(2) = 2.
role: Perrin (plastic Lucas / trace)

name: Numerators in expansion of (1 - x)^(-3/2).
role: numerators of 2w C(2w,w)/4^w = B_{1/2}(box) / h, the half-order block count of a box castle (fractional-block-count)

name: Apply partial sum operator twice to Fibonacci numbers.
role: one-peak castles of area n+1: (1^a, X, 1^b) with X free of height-1 columns

name: Companion Pell numbers: a(n) = 2*a(n-1) + a(n-2), a(0) = a(1) = 2.
role: companion Pell (trace of Pell)

name: Central trinomial coefficients: largest coefficient of (1 + x + x^2)^n.
role: unconstrained U/R/D words returning to height 0; Motzkin is the ballot-restricted version

name: Numerators in expansion of sqrt(1+x). Absolute values give numerators in expansion of sqrt(1-x).
role: numerators of the half-order Grunwald-Letnikov weights (-1)^k C(1/2,k) (fractional-block-count)

name: Quarter-squares: a(n) = floor(n/2)*ceiling(n/2). Equivalently, a(n) = floor(n^2/4).
role: two-block castles of area n (1^a 2^m 1^c)

name: Expansion of (1-x)^(-3) * (1-x^2)^(-2).
role: three-block two-peak castles of area n+5

name: Number of bicoverings of an n-set.
role: Bender's c((0,n)): partitions of a multiset with every element twice, no repeated blocks, no repeated element in a block

name: Carmichael numbers.
role: first four terms 561, 1105, 1729, 2465 are all castle counts: odd(3,34), A(4,7), F(6,4), A(4,9)

name: Number of acyclic digraphs (or DAGs) with n labeled nodes.
role: strip rules with all eigenvalues real and positive, i.e. I + nilpotent: 3, 25, 543 at heights 2, 3, 4 (fractional-width-and-height)

name: Numbers that are the sum of 3 positive cubes.
role: castle counts as sums of three positive cubes: 56 of 552 even counts with w >= 4 below 10^8 (background rate); F(4,2) = 1+1+8, F(6,3) = 27+64+216, F(5,8) = 13^3+14^3+16^3

name: Decimal equivalent of Gray code for n.
role: reflected Gray code (Knuth Algorithm G); the castle Gray code thread

name: Numbers that are the sum of 2 positive cubes.
role: F(6,4) = 1729 and F(4,85) = 5^3 + 93^3 are the only nondegenerate two-cube even counts below 10^9; height-2 row gives 2c^3 at w = 5 (mod 12) and c^3 + d^3 at w = 19 (mod 24)

name: Generalized Catalan numbers: a(n+1) = a(n) + Sum_{k=2..n-1} a(k)*a(n-1-k).
role: tower word growth (algebraic GF, growth 1+√2)

name: a(n) = 5^n - 4^n.
role: h^w - (h-1)^w at h=5

name: a(n) = 4^n - 3^n.
role: h^w - (h-1)^w at h=4

name: a(n) = 6^n - 5^n.
role: h^w - (h-1)^w at h=6

name: a(0) = 0, a(1) = a(2) = a(3) = 1; thereafter, a(n) = a(n-1) + a(n-2) + a(n-4).
role: **four linked castle readings** (the multi-interpretation hub on [[castle-sequence-catalogue](pages/castle-sequence-catalogue.md)]): Hardin no-isolated-1 words / `P_even(6,L)/2^L`; tree castles by area (`h→∞`); tower-spacing `(h=2,g=2)`; unified by [[a005251-bijection](pages/a005251-bijection.md)]

name: a(n) = Sum_{k=0..floor(n/4)} binomial(n-2k,2k).
role: minimum-tower-spacing `(h=2, g=3)` castles, `a(w+3)`; golden growth

name: Number of binary words of length n in which the ones occur only in blocks of length at least 4.
role: minimum-tower-spacing `(h=2, g=4)` castles, `a(w+3)`

name: The odd numbers: a(n) = 2*n + 1.
role: tower Narayana coefficient row

name: Number of column-convex polyominoes with perimeter 2n+2.
role: column-convex polyominoes by perimeter (neighbor family)

name: Number of convex polygons of perimeter 2n on square lattice.
role: convex polyominoes by perimeter (Delest-Viennot)

name: Number of Twopins positions.
role: minimum-tower-spacing `(h=2, g=5)` castles, `a(w+6)`

name: Centered pentagonal numbers: (5n^2+5n+2)/2; crystal ball sequence for 3.3.3.4.4. planar net.
role: tower Narayana coefficient row

name: Rhombic dodecahedral numbers: n^4 - (n-1)^4.
role: A(4,h) = h^4 - (h-1)^4; contains the Carmichael numbers 1105 (h=7) and 2465 (h=9)

name: a(n) = a(n-1) + 3*a(n-2) for n > 1, a(0) = a(1) = 1.
role: tree castles of height 4: T_4(w) = a(w+1)

name: a(n) = a(n-1) + 4*a(n-2), a(0) = a(1) = 1.
role: tree castles of height 5: T_5(w) = a(w+1)

name: a(n) = 3*a(n-1) + a(n-2), with a(0)=0, a(1)=1.
role: bronze metallic sequence: a(n) = 3a(n-1) + a(n-2)

name: a(n) = 3*a(n-1) + a(n-2) with a(0) = 2, a(1) = 3.
role: trace sequence for bronze

name: a(n) = a(n-1) + a(n-3) + a(n-4), a(0) = a(1) = a(2) = 1, a(3) = 2.
role: tree castles of height 3 by area: T_(h=3)(A) = A006498(A+1); GF denominator factors as (1+q^2)(1-q-q^2), giving golden growth

name: Number of parallelogram polyominoes with n cells (also called staircase polyominoes, although that term is overused).
role: parallelogram polyominoes by area, the q-Bessel rung

name: Pascal's triangle read by rows: C(n,k) = binomial(n,k) = n!/(k!*(n-k)!), 0 <= k <= n.
role: the binomial toolkit behind every binomial castle count

name: Number of numerical semigroups of genus n; conjecturally also the number of power sum bases for symmetric functions in n variables.
role: the coin/semigroup branch of the block-count trichotomy; golden-ratio growth (Zhai 2013)

name: Exponent of highest power of 2 dividing n, a.k.a. the binary carry sequence, the ruler sequence, or the 2-adic valuation of n.
role: Knuth's ruler function ρ(k), the bit to flip in Gray-code generation

name: Triangle of Stirling numbers of the second kind, S2(n,k), n >= 1, 1 <= k <= n.
role: Knuth's binomial-coefficient toolkit (powers ↔ falling factorials)

name: Triangle of Mahonian numbers T(n,k): coefficients in expansion of Product_{i=0..n-1} (1 + x + ... + x^i), where k ranges from 0 to A000217(n-1). Also enumerates permutations by their major index.
role: rainbow castles (w = h, skyline a permutation) graded by skyline inversions

name: Expansion of e.g.f. sin(x)*exp(x).
role: -P_odd(1,L): signed count of towers of height <= 1 (castles of height <= 2) with odd last column

name: Inverse of 6th cyclotomic polynomial. A period 6 sequence.
role: period-6 cyclotomic (P_odd(4,L)/2^L)

name: Coefficients of expansion of (1-x)/(1-2*x) in powers of x.
role: weakly unimodal compositions (unrestricted)

name: Even Lucas numbers: a(n) = L(3*n).
role: even Lucas: trace for copper (a=4)

name: Odd triangular numbers.
role: odd triangular numbers (row of A352116)

name: a(0) = 1, a(1) = 1, and a(n) = 4*a(n-1) + a(n-2) for n >= 2.
role: copper free strip (`h=5`), `=F_{3n+5}` trisection, growth `φ³`

name: Number of multigraphs on n labeled edges (without loops).
role: Bender's v((0,n)): every element twice, repeated blocks allowed, no repeated element in a block

name: Number of multigraphs on n labeled edges (with loops). Also number of genetically distinct states amongst n individuals.
role: Bender's v*((0,n)): all partitions of a multiset with every element twice

name: Triangle of trinomial coefficients T(n,k) (n >= 0, 0 <= k <= 2*n), read by rows: n-th row is obtained by expanding (1 + x + x^2)^n.
role: unconstrained U/R/D words by final height, the ceiling the castle grammar prunes

name: a(n) = Fibonacci(3*n + 1).
role: F(3n+1): copper-delta convergent numerators

name: Triangular array formed by taking every other term of each row of Pascal's triangle.
role: Pascal every-other row (binomial identity)

name: Triangle T(n,k) read by rows: multinomial coefficients for the partitions of n listed in Abramowitz-Stegun order, 1 <= k <= A000041(n).
role: multiset-permutation counts (Knuth Vol. 1 / Vol. 3)

name: Sum of every 4th entry of row n in Pascal's triangle, starting at "n choose 0".
role: odd(w,2) + 1: odd-block height-2 castles

name: Sum of every 4th entry of row n in Pascal's triangle, starting at "n choose 1".
role: sum of every 4th binomial (hyperbolic family, k=1 residue)

name: Sum of every 4th entry of row n in Pascal's triangle, starting at binomial(n,2).
role: F(w,2): even-block height-2 castles

name: Numerators of continued fraction convergents to sqrt(8).
role: numerators of CF convergents to √8

name: Denominators of continued fraction convergents to sqrt(8).
role: denominators of CF convergents to √8

name: Numerators of continued fraction convergents to sqrt(13).
role: numerators of CF convergents to √13

name: Denominators of continued fraction convergents to sqrt(13).
role: denominators of CF convergents to √13

name: Numerators of continued fraction convergents to sqrt(20).
role: numerators of CF convergents to √20

name: Denominators of continued fraction convergents to sqrt(20).
role: denominators of CF convergents to √20

name: Numerators of continued fraction convergents to sqrt(29).
role: numerators of CF convergents to √29

name: Denominators of continued fraction convergents to sqrt(29).
role: denominators of CF convergents to √29

name: Number of 1's in all compositions of n+1.
role: total height-1 columns over castles of area n; mean prime-factor count (n+6)/4

name: a(n) = denominator of binomial(2n,n)/4^n.
role: denominators of the half-order Grunwald-Letnikov weights and of the chain-rule half-column C(2k,k)/4^k (fractional-block-count, fractional-width-and-height)

name: Coefficient of x^(-n) in expansion of continued fraction 0, x, x^2, x^3, x^4, ... .
role: height-signed parallelogram polyominoes by area are `-A049346(n)`

name: Diophantine equation x^3 + y^3 = z^3 + 1 with 1 < x < y < z ("Fermat near misses").
role: 1729 = 9^3+10^3 = 12^3+1 is the first term; the n=-1 row of Ramanujan's recurrence

name: Ramanujan's a-series: expansion of (1+53x+9x^2)/(1-82x-82x^2+x^3).
role: near-miss family a_n^3+b_n^3 = c_n^3+(-1)^n; growth delta_9^2, the ninth metallic mean squared (height-10 ceiling-exception strip)

name: Ramanujan's b-series: expansion of (2-26x-12x^2)/(1-82x-82x^2+x^3).
role: b-series of the near-miss family; same denominator (1+x)(1-83x+x^2)

name: Ramanujan's c-series: expansion of (2+8x-10x^2)/(1-82x-82x^2+x^3).
role: c-series of the near-miss family; Berlekamp-Massey on c_0..c_11 recovers the order-3 recurrence

name: Number of strongly connected tournaments on n nodes.
role: the strong tournaments among which Tetali's four basic unique tournaments sit (1 of 1, 1 of 1, 1 of 6 at n = 3, 4, 5; 0 of 35, 0 of 353 at n = 6, 7)

name: a(0) = 1, a(1) = 5, a(n+1) = 5*a(n) + a(n-1).
role: nickel metallic sequence: a(n) = 5a(n-1) + a(n-2)

name: Expansion of g.f.: (1-x)/(1 - 3*x - x^2).
role: bronze delta-1 CF numerators: (1-x)/(1-3x-x²)

name: Decimal expansion of real root of x^3 - x - 1 (the plastic constant).
role: decimal expansion of plastic constant ψ

name: Numbers that are not congruent to 4 or 5 mod 9.
role: the conjectural sums of three cubes; F(w,h) mod 9 periodic in both directions, so membership of castle counts is decided cell by cell

name: Smallest solution x of x^3 + y^3 + z^3 = n for n in A060464.
role: companion table of smallest three-cube representations; not deep enough (58 terms) to cover the castle counts 367, 439, 903

name: Smallest solution y of x^3 + y^3 + z^3 = n for n in A060464.
role: companion table of smallest three-cube representations

name: Smallest solution z of x^3 + y^3 + z^3 = n for n in A060464.
role: companion table of smallest three-cube representations

name: Tricoverings of an n-set.
role: Bender's c((0,0,n)): every element three times, no repeated blocks, no repeated element in a block

name: a(n) = (2*n - 1)*(7*n^2 - 7*n + 6)/6.
role: tower Narayana coefficient row

name: a(n) = (2*n - 1)*(8*n^2 - 8*n + 3)/3.
role: P(2m,4) bisection: C_3 lattice crystal-ball sequence

name: Number of fixed convex polyominoes with n cells.
role: convex polyominoes by area; the convex castle with a floating base

name: Number of fixed directed convex polyominoes with n cells.
role: directed convex polyominoes by area

name: a(n) = 10*n^2 + 5*n + 1.
role: odd(3, 2n+1) = 5 C(2n+1, 2) + 1 exactly; its negative-index half 10m^2 - 5m + 1 is F(3, 2m) = 6, 31, 76, 141, ..., not in OEIS (novel candidate)

name: Expansion of (1 + x^2 - sqrt( 1 - 4*x + 2*x^2 + x^4)) / (2*x) in powers of x.
role: castles (bargraphs) by semi-perimeter w + #blocks; growth tribonacci squared

name: Number of n X n real (0,1)-matrices with all eigenvalues >= 0.
role: strip rules with a real principal square root: 13, 261, 15418 at heights 2, 3, 4 (fractional-width-and-height)

name: a(n) = 5*a(n-1)+a(n-2) for n>1, a(0)=2, a(1)=5.
role: trace for nickel (a=5)

name: Number of (<=2)-covers of an n-set.
role: Bender's c*((0,n)): every element twice, no repeated blocks, repeated elements in a block allowed

name: Number of unlabeled regular tournaments with 2n+1 nodes.
role: 1, 1, 3 at 3, 5, 7 nodes: the regular score vectors (1,1,1), (2,2,2,2,2) are unique, (3,3,3,3,3,3,3) has three realizers

name: Expansion of 1/((1-x)^2*(1-x^2)^2*(1-x^3)).
role: three-block one-peak castles of area n+3

name: a(n) = Sum_{k=0..floor(n/7)} C(n-5*k,2*k).
role: minimum-tower-spacing `(h=2, g=6)` castles, `a(w+6)`

name: Secondary diagonal of triangle A100235 divided by row number: a(n) = A100235(n+1,n)/(n+1) for n >= 0.
role: nickel delta-1 CF numerators: (1-x)/(1-5x-x²)

name: Triangle read by rows: T(n,k) is the number of compositions of n having exactly k parts equal to 1.
role: prime-factor counts of castles by area (k+1 factors for k height-1 columns)

name: Lucas and Lehmer numbers with parameters (1 +- sqrt(-7))/2.
role: Lucas-Lehmer with (1±√-7)/2 (P_odd(2,L) at k=2)

name: a(n) = n^2*(n^2 - 1)/3.
role: A_5(k): alternating part of P(k,5) quasi-polynomial

name: The number of compositions of n which cannot be viewed as stacks.
role: non-convex castles by area

name: Triangle of unsigned Stirling numbers of the first kind (see A048994), read by rows, T(n,k) for 0 <= k <= n.
role: [n,1] = (n−1)!, the cycle-count anchor of the castle triad

name: Expansion of (1-x)/(1 - 2*x + 2*x^2).
role: P(1,L): signed tower count at k=1, Re((1+i)^{L+1})

name: Numbers that are congruent to 4 or 5 mod 9.
role: the excluded residues; F(w,2) lands here iff w = 9 (mod 12), F(3,h) iff h = 4, 6 (mod 18), A(3m,h) never

name: Expansion of (1 + 10*x + 20*x^2 + 10*x^3 + x^4)/(1-x)^5.
role: tower Narayana coefficient row

name: Number of tri-coverings of a set.
role: Bender's v((0,0,n)): every element three times, repeated blocks allowed, no repeated element in a block

name: Number of -n..n arrays of 4 elements with zero sum and no two neighbors summing to zero.
role: |P(2m+1,4)|: signed height-1 towers on length-4 base, odd k

name: Number of n X 1 0..2 arrays with every nonzero element less than or equal to some horizontal or vertical neighbor.
role: Hardin words at m=2: P_even(10,L)/2^L

name: T(n,k)=Number of nXk 0..2 arrays with every nonzero element less than or equal to some horizontal or vertical neighbor.
role: 2D Hardin table (row axis of A202882)

name: Number of nX1 0..5 arrays with every nonzero element less than or equal to some horizontal or vertical neighbor.
role: Hardin words at m=5; minimum-tower-spacing `(h=6, g=2)` castles, `a(w+1)`

name: Number of nX1 0..3 arrays with every nonzero element less than or equal to some horizontal or vertical neighbor.
role: Hardin words at m=3: P_even(14,L)/2^L

name: Number of n X 1 0..4 arrays with every nonzero element less than or equal to some horizontal or vertical neighbor.
role: Hardin words at m=4: P_even(18,L)/2^L

name: Number of n-element 0..2 arrays with each element the minimum of 3 adjacent elements of a random 0..2 array of n+2 elements.
role: minimum-tower-spacing `(h=3, g=3)` castles: 0..2 "min of 3 adjacent" arrays

name: Number of n element 0..2 arrays with each element the minimum of 4 adjacent elements of a random 0..2 array of n+3 elements.
role: minimum-tower-spacing `(h=3, g=4)` castles

name: Number of n element 0..2 arrays with each element the minimum of 5 adjacent elements of a random 0..2 array of n+4 elements.
role: minimum-tower-spacing `(h=3, g=5)` castles

name: Number of n element 0..2 arrays with each element the minimum of 6 adjacent elements of a random 0..2 array of n+5 elements.
role: minimum-tower-spacing `(h=3, g=6)` castles
